title: Bring your own icons
subtitle: SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, from a file or written into the spec
description: Four boxes, each with an icon that is not built in: a line SVG that takes the box's colour, a coloured SVG, a PNG that is not square, and an SVG written straight into the spec.

icons.tag: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.7' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M3 12V4h8l10 10-8 8z'/><circle cx='8' cy='9' r='1.6'/></svg>

callouts.text: An SVG that draws in currentColor takes the box's colour, like the built-in icons.
A picture keeps its shape and its own colours. It is fitted inside the icon square.

steps.caption: A line SVG from a file. It is navy because the box is.
A coloured SVG keeps its own colours.
This one is written into the spec. It turns teal with its box.
A PNG works too, even one that is not square.
